dataset_identity.primary_use: Agricultural RAG + pest/disease decision support + vision routing + Tamil voice interface
dataset_identity.review_governance: Source-level review metadata with 6-month review interval

pest_corpus.description: Source-grounded rice pest knowledge for Tamil Nadu. 8 canonical pests.

records.title: TNAU Rice Pest Management Guide — Stem Borer
records.growth_stage: All stages; dead heart in vegetative, white earhead in reproductive
distinguishing_cues: Egg masses on leaf tips
Larvae with brown head and white body inside stem
Moth with silvery white wings with black spots
Dead heart symptom in vegetative stage
White earhead (empty panicle) in reproductive stage
records.etl_action_threshold: Vegetative: 1 egg mass/m² or 10% dead hearts; Reproductive: 1 egg mass/m² or 5% white ears
records.management_summary: Use resistant varieties (CO 51, ADT 43); remove and destroy egg masses; apply carbofuran 3G @ 33 kg/ha at planting; release Trichogramma japonicum @ 50,000/ha; spray chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 150 ml/ha if ETL exceeded.
records.citation: TNAU Agritech Portal, Rice Pest Management

records.title: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank — Brown Planthopper Management
records.region: Tamil Nadu, India; applicable across South India
records.growth_stage: All stages; most damaging at tillering to flowering
distinguishing_cues: Brown body with white bands on mid-dorsal abdomen
Wings held roof-like over body
Nymphs with white waxy filaments
Hopper burn — yellowing and drying of crop in circular patches
Honeydew secretion leading to sooty mold
records.etl_action_threshold: Seedling: 1-2 nymphs/hill; Vegetative: 5-10 nymphs/hill; Reproductive: 10-20 nymphs/hill
records.management_summary: Use resistant varieties (ADT 36, ASD 16); avoid excessive nitrogen; maintain 2-5 cm water level; apply buprofezin 25 SC @ 400 ml/ha; conserve natural enemies like Cyrtorhinus lividipennis.
records.citation: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank - BPH Management

records.title: TNAU Rice Pest Management Guide — Leaf Folder
distinguishing_cues: Leaves folded longitudinally with silken threads
Larvae inside folded leaves feeding on green tissue
White streaks on leaves due to feeding
Adult moth with golden yellow wings
Reduced photosynthetic area
records.etl_action_threshold: Vegetative: 1 larva/hill or 10% folded leaves; Reproductive: 2 larvae/hill or 20% folded leaves
records.management_summary: Avoid close planting; remove grassy weeds from bunds; apply chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 150 ml/ha; use light traps for moth monitoring; conserve parasitoids like Trichogramma chilonis.

records.title: ICAR Rice Production Manual — Green Leafhopper
records.region: Tamil Nadu, India; all rice-growing regions of India
records.growth_stage: All stages; vector activity critical in early vegetative
distinguishing_cues: Bright green body with black markings
Wings with black spots
Active jumping when disturbed
Yellowing of leaves from tip downwards
Vector for rice tungro virus
records.etl_action_threshold: Seedling: 5 hoppers/hill; Vegetative: 10-15 hoppers/hill; Reproductive: 20 hoppers/hill
records.management_summary: Use resistant varieties (CO 51); remove weed hosts; apply imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 100 ml/ha; control virus by managing vector population; apply neem-based insecticides as preventive.

records.title: TNAU Gall Midge Management in Rice
records.region: Tamil Nadu, India; endemic in Cauvery delta and coastal districts
distinguishing_cues: Silver shoot or onion shoot formation at base of tillers
Galls at base of tillers containing maggot
Empty panicles in affected tillers
Adult fly with long legs and antennae
Reddish brown pupa at base of gall
records.etl_action_threshold: Vegetative: 5% silver shoots or 1 adult/100 sweeps
records.management_summary: Use resistant varieties (Kavya, Surekha); plough during summer to destroy pupae; apply carbofuran 3G @ 33 kg/ha at planting; avoid late planting in gall midge endemic areas; release Platygaster orseoliae parasitoids.

records.title: KVK Rice Nursery Management — Thrips Control
distinguishing_cues: Tiny slender insects (1-2 mm) with fringed wings
Dark brown to black body
Yellow to orange discoloration of leaves
Silvery patches on leaf surface
Rolling of leaf tips inward
records.management_summary: Submerge nursery periodically; avoid dry conditions in nursery; apply thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 100 g/ha; use blue sticky traps for monitoring; maintain adequate water level in field.

records.title: TNAU Whorl Maggot Management in Rice
distinguishing_cues: Maggot inside leaf whorl feeding on central leaf tissue
Typical feeding marks on young leaves
Damaged leaves unfold with ragged appearance
Small black fly with smoky wings
Eggs on leaf surface near water line
records.management_summary: Drain water periodically to expose maggots; apply carbofuran 3G @ 33 kg/ha; use neem cake @ 250 kg/ha in nursery; avoid continuous flooding in early stages; conserve natural enemies.

records.title: ICAR Rice Insect Pest Management — Earhead Bug
records.region: Tamil Nadu, India; all rice-growing regions
distinguishing_cues: Slender greenish-brown bug (15-20 mm) with long antennae and legs
Nymphs with black and white bands
Empty and chaffy grains
Discolored and shriveled grains
Reduced grain quality and market value
records.etl_action_threshold: Flowering: 5 bugs/100 panicles; Milking: 10 bugs/100 panicles
records.management_summary: Use light traps to monitor adult activity; apply malathion 50 EC @ 500 ml/ha; avoid staggered planting; synchronize planting in area; remove alternate hosts.
